title: Read Discrete Inputs with high address and minimal quantity
purpose: Combine a high register-like address with a minimal quantity and a non-default unit identifier to explore address, quantity, and unit-field interactions in a valid Read Discrete Inputs request.

messages.label: Read Discrete Inputs request, unit 01, address 64715, quantity 1

expected_behavior: A conforming server should parse the request as one Read Discrete Inputs operation at the high address and either return one input bit or a normal exception response if the address is outside its mapping.
constraints_preserved: MBAP length 0006 matches the unit identifier and five-byte request PDU.
Address fc9b represents 64715 and quantity is 0001.
Function code 02 matches Read Discrete Inputs.
Hex is lowercase and contains no separators.
issue_safety_notes: The high address and quantity-one combination is an issue-guided field interaction, not a reproduction of the DWord register trace. No response-length mismatch or truncated request is introduced.
